text: Remove the butt-mounted loop with battery and wiring in the stem. Keep the bare wand usable with no projecting rails, brackets or release tabs. Keep the loop ends seated directly into the wand.

Keep the control group positioned above the butt loop with its original angles, height spacing and upper thumb projection. Keep cap access and mirror both hands. A connector location must accommodate that grip position.
A complete print project includes both handed handles. Preserve the mirrored control positions, board retention, upward USB and battery wiring. Compare mass per one complete wand.
The trial with a much greater difference in spiral pitch was followed by a preference for the previous spiral.
Provide a horizontal top control surface across the shaft rather than only a narrow ledge on one side.

Offer both a proper mug-style finger loop and a bare wand with interchangeable handles on the shared attachment. Use the XIAO sensor and the intended rechargeable pack rather than the earlier Puck and AA block.

Carry two visible counter-wound spirals down a continuously tapering shaft. Preserve the preferred earlier spiral with both handles. Avoid a pinched waist, renewed widening or external joint collar. Reinforce internally and allow the diamond to widen above its narrow neck.
Reduce radius and material toward the tip of the tube, keeping the sensor at the end. The board holder may widen locally to fit the real board.
Where the grip is vented, open the actual skin-contact surface to air. Keep openings separate from the full decorative spirals and preserve loaded lands and the joint, battery and switch regions.
